subject: Music Production
title: Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis
description: A 60-second lesson on Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis.

hook.text: Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis played in Prince's band but were fired after missing a concert.

buildup.text: Instead of giving up, they built a production partnership in Minneapolis and started making beats.

discovery.text: Janet Jackson hired them, and their album 'Control' launched her as a solo superstar in 1986.

twist.text: Prince, who had fired them, watched his former sidemen become his biggest production rivals.

climax.text: Jam and Lewis produced over one hundred gold and platinum records across multiple genres.

punchline.text: Getting fired by Prince was the best career move.

quiz.question: Which artist's career did Jam and Lewis help launch?
